$comment: TEST FIXTURE — deliberately invalid. Narrows the inherited capability group's coverage from the whole purpose vocabulary to the purposes in scope, so a supplier would conform while saying nothing at all about the purposes the profile defers. That is precisely the floor decision 0010 exists to prevent, arriving by a different route. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Narrowing an inherited group's coverage (test fixture)
